name: CoupleHedgeEA v3.0
summary: A multi-currency couple hedging EA that uses 3-5 currencies to form 3-30 pair groups, opening correlated hedge positions (plus/minus suites) on each group. It manages positions with configurable step progressions (statical/geometrical/exponential), multiple close-in-profit modes (side-by-side, both-sides, hybrid), and includes session control, spread filtering, and auto lot sizing.
summary_zh: 这是一个多货币对冲EA，使用3-5种货币组成3-30个货币对组，在每个组上开立相关性对冲仓位（正向/反向组合）。它支持可配置的步进递增（静态/几何/指数）、多种获利平仓模式（逐侧、双侧、混合），并包含时段控制、点差过滤和自动手数计算功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于货币对之间的相关性对冲，从3-5种货币中组合出多个货币对组（couple），每组包含两个货币对。入场条件是当两个货币对形成特定方向组合时同时开仓——如果两对共享相同基础货币或报价货币则一买一卖，否则同向开仓，形成Plus和Minus两个对冲组合。出场条件支持五种获利平仓模式（逐侧平仓、双侧平仓、混合1、混合2、混合1+2）以及亏损平仓模式。仓位管理采用递进式加仓，支持三种步进模式（静态步长、几何步长、指数步长）和四种手数递进模式（静态手数、几何递增、指数递增、递减手数），在亏损时按设定步长逐步加仓。资金管理提供自动手数计算和风险因子控制，同时设有最大手数限制、最大订单数限制、点差过滤和交易时段控制（周一开盘等待、周五收盘前停止）来管控风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on correlation hedging between currency pairs, combining 3-5 currencies into multiple pair groups (couples), each containing two pairs. Entry conditions open positions simultaneously on both pairs in a group — if the two pairs share the same base or quote currency, one buys and one sells; otherwise both trade in the same direction, forming Plus andMinus hedging suites. Exit conditions support five profit-close modes (side-by-side, both-sides, hybrid 1, hybrid 2, and hybrid 1+2) along with configurable loss-close modes (whole side, partial side, or no loss close). Position sizing uses progressive scaling with three step progression modes (statical, geometrical, exponential) and four lot progression modes (static, geometrical, exponential, decreasing lot), adding positions at set step intervals when in loss. Money management offers auto lot sizing with a risk factor, maximum lot size limits, maximum order count limits, spread filtering, and session control (waiting after Monday open, stopping before Friday close) to manage overall risk exposure.

pros: 多货币对冲设计，利用货币相关性分散单一方向风险
灵活的步进和手数递进模式（静态/几何/指数），适应不同市场波动环境
具备完善的交易时段控制（周一开盘等待、周五收盘前停止）和点差过滤，降低低流动性时段风险
支持最多5种货币30个对冲组，提供丰富的组合灵活性
具有获利和亏损双重平仓机制，以及多种混合平仓模式供选择
pros_en: Multi-currency hedging design leverages currency correlations to diversify directional risk
Flexible step and lot progression modes (statical/geometrical/exponential) adapt to different volatility environments
Session control (Monday open wait, Friday close stop) and spread filtering reduce low-liquidity period risks
Supports up to 5 currencies forming 30 hedge groups, offering rich combination flexibility
Dual close mechanism for both profit and loss with multiple hybrid close modes available
cons: 几何/指数步进加仓在持续亏损时会导致仓位和风险急剧膨胀，具有隐性马丁格尔特征
代码中大量使用全局变量和固定大小数组，可维护性差且难以扩展
默认配置下不在亏损时平仓（Not_Close_In_Loss），可能导致浮亏无限扩大
货币对组合逻辑硬编码，无法动态适应不同经纪商的品种列表
缺少止损机制，完全依赖对冲组合和获利/亏损目标来控制风险，极端行情下可能爆仓
cons_en: Geometrical/exponential step progression causes position size and risk to escalate rapidly during sustained losses, exhibiting implicit martingale characteristics
Heavy use of global variables and fixed-size arrays results in poor maintainability and limited extensibility
Default configuration does not close in loss (Not_Close_In_Loss), potentially allowing floating losses to grow indefinitely
Currency pair combination logic is hardcoded and cannot dynamically adapt to different broker symbol lists
No stop-loss mechanism — relies entirely on hedging combinations and profit/loss targets for risk control, risking account blow-up in extreme markets
improvements: 增加硬止损机制，为每个对冲组设置最大浮亏限额，防止极端行情下账户爆仓
将硬编码的货币对组合逻辑重构为动态生成算法，提高代码可维护性和扩展性
加入新K线检查（New Bar检测），避免每个Tick都执行完整逻辑，降低CPU和服务器负载
improvements_en: Add hard stop-loss mechanism with maximum floating loss limit per hedge group to prevent account blow-up in extreme markets
Refactor hardcoded currency pair combination logic into a dynamic generation algorithm for better maintainability and extensibility
Implement new bar detection to avoid executing full logic on every tick, reducing CPU and server load

risk_points: 几何/指数步进加仓在连续亏损时仓位指数级增长，隐含马丁格尔风险
默认不设亏损平仓，浮亏可无限扩大直至爆仓
缺少硬止损，完全依赖对冲组合盈利来平仓，极端单边行情下对冲失效
无新K线检查机制，高频Tick环境下可能过度交易
risk_points_en: Geometrical/exponential step progression causes exponential position growth during consecutive losses, creating implicit martingale risk
Default no-loss-close setting allows floating losses to grow indefinitely until margin call
No hard stop-loss — relies entirely on hedge pair profits for closure, which fails in extreme trending markets
No new bar check mechanism may lead to over-trading in high-frequency tick environments
